history.summary: Saved plan to docs/PLAN.md; added §30 loot-shooter core specification.
Scaffold: LICENSE, README, .gitignore, CMake C++20 skeleton, ASSETS.toml, CREDITS.md, 4 Kenney CC0 packs.
SDL3 + Vulkan 1.3 triangle; validation only if installed; headless + 3 s window smoke tests pass (0 validation msgs, layer absent).
Added BUILD_PLAN.md with Standing rules (every hourly run) and step table; created build_state.json history log.

Moved BUILD_PLAN.md and build_state.json into docs/. Expanded plan from 12 to 45 ~1-hour steps through a minimal playable vertical slice (loot drops/pickup/inventory, XP, HUD/UI, key bindings, Breach room + mini-boss, Kenney audio, save round-trip, playtest passes); split oversized M0/M1 steps; each step has Does/Files/Done.

CI workflow .github/workflows/ci.yml (ubuntu-24.04, clang, Ninja, lavapipe forced via VK_DRIVER_FILES, validation layers installed, ctest -LE window); not pushed. Bug fix: Ubuntu 24.04 has no SDL3 package, so CMake now falls back to FetchContent SDL3 release-3.4.18 (COE_FETCH_SDL3 forces it; CI uses SDL_UNIX_CONSOLE_BUILD). Done check: YAML parses; ctest -LE window passes with system SDL3 (GCC) and in a CI emulation (clang, fetched static SDL3, lavapipe-only); full ctest incl. window also green. Plan: step 5 lint stdlib-only + runs in CI; step 7 adds asan preset + ASan/UBSan CI job, Windows/clang-tidy/format deferred. Magewar: ~/game has only .github issue templates, no workflows; corrected PLAN.md §1. Its headless logic-test runner matches our headless-ctest approach.

Added PLAN.md §31 (original loot architecture: Patterns with merge modes, requires/forbids constraints, Workshop signatures, weight model, Consecrations, Vigils/Omens, Ember Mark item codes, balance patches, level layers) and §32 What we learned (public BLCM/apocalyptech docs only; no game files or keys). Refined §30.2. BUILD_PLAN: inserted 5 steps (27 Patterns + constraints, 29 Ember Mark codes, 30 Balance patch loader, 35 Weight model + Vigil plumbing, 43 Consecrations); old steps 27-45 renumbered to 28-50; steps 40/46/47 text refined. Plan now has 50 steps; total_steps field left unchanged per instruction. next_step unchanged (5).
